3	import (
4		"bytes"
5		"encoding/json"
6		"fmt"
7		"io"
8		"sort"
9		"strconv"
10		"strings"
11	)
12	
13	// Saved proof-job records used to be read and field-checked twice: once while
14	// the committed envelope was tokenized to reject a repeated object key
15	// (scanJobArray) and again while each jobs element was decoded into a
16	// persistJob (persistJob.UnmarshalJSON). Each pass gathered the record's
17	// member keys on its own and carried its own copy of the pinned-version and
18	// compiled-binding spelling rules, so the rule for naming a job, pinning a
19	// version or reading the optional compiled hash lived in two places that had
20	// to agree by construction.
21	//
22	// This file is now the single home of a saved job's reading and validation
23	// rules: the persistJob shape, the accepted spellings of its named fields
24	// (id / circuit / version / compiled_hash), the id exact-readback rule, the
25	// owning-circuit and pinned-version uniqueness rules and the compiled-binding
26	// duplicate/lookalike/type rules, together with one per-record reading engine (readJobRecord) both read passes drive. The
27	// directory scan and the single-record decode hence tokenize one record once
28	// and judge its keys and structure through the same code, which also covers
29	// two byte-identical member keys — a case a post-decode member map could not
30	// see on its own.
31	//
32	// Only the reading of saved jobs is consolidated here. The public behavior —
33	// which values load, which are refused, how the failure is located and in
34	// what order findings surface — is unchanged; the commit and query entry
35	// points and the on-disk format stay as they were. In particular the two read
36	// passes keep their historical division of labor and precedence because an
37	// open always runs the directory scan before the typed decode: the scan owns
38	// structural findings, the pinned-version and owning-circuit ambiguities,
39	// exact repeated keys and nested repeated keys (jobRecordScan.judge), while
40	// the typed decode owns the
41	// binding-field lookalike, duplicate-binding and binding-value-type findings
42	// plus the ordinary struct decode (decodeJob).
43	
44	type persistJob struct {
45		ID       string `json:"id"`
46		Circuit  string `json:"circuit"`
47		Version  int    `json:"version"`
48		Kind     string `json:"kind"`
49		Attempt  int    `json:"attempt"`
50		Artifact string `json:"artifact,omitempty"`
51		// CompiledHash is the optional binding to the pinned version's compiled
52		// artifact, stored exactly as submitted.
53		CompiledHash string `json:"compiled_hash,omitempty"`
54	}
55	
56	// The canonical spellings of the job-record fields the read path treats by
57	// rule rather than leaving entirely to a plain struct decode. Keys reach
58	// every rule below already JSON-unescaped, so a key written with a \uXXXX
59	// escape is judged on its decoded spelling too.
60	const (
61		jobIDKey        = "id"
62		jobCircuitKey   = "circuit"
63		jobVersionKey   = "version"
64		compiledHashKey = "compiled_hash"
65	)
66	
67	// isASCIIFoldOf reports whether key names canonical under an ASCII-only
68	// letter-case fold: the two must have the same byte length and every byte
69	// must match after mapping A-Z onto a-z. A key of a different length, or one
70	// that needs a non-ASCII rune to match, returns false — use strings.EqualFold
71	// to detect those non-ASCII lookalikes separately.
72	func isASCIIFoldOf(key, canonical string) bool {
73		if len(key) != len(canonical) {
74			return false
75		}
76		for i := 0; i < len(key); i++ {
77			c := key[i]
78			if c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' {
79				c += 'a' - 'A'
80			}
81			if c != canonical[i] {
82				return false
83			}
84		}
85		return true
86	}
87	
88	// isJobVersionKey reports whether key names a job record's pinned circuit
89	// version field under any spelling the ordinary decode fills Version from:
90	// canonical "version", an ASCII letter-case variant such as "VERSION" or
91	// "VeRsIoN", or a JSON-escaped spelling that unescapes onto either. Because
92	// encoding/json's struct-tag matching folds with Unicode case rules
93	// (strings.EqualFold), the long-s "verſion" (U+017F, written directly or as
94	// the u017f escape) names the field too.
95	func isJobVersionKey(key string) bool {
96		return strings.EqualFold(key, jobVersionKey)
97	}
98	
99	// isJobCircuitKey reports whether key names a job record's owning circuit
100	// field under any spelling the ordinary decode fills Circuit from: canonical
101	// "circuit" or an ASCII letter-case variant such as "CIRCUIT" or "CiRcUiT",
102	// including a JSON-escaped spelling that unescapes onto either (keys arrive
103	// here already unescaped). No non-ASCII rune case-folds onto any letter of
104	// "circuit", so the ASCII fold and encoding/json's Unicode-folded tag
105	// matching recognize exactly the same keys for this field.
106	func isJobCircuitKey(key string) bool {
107		return isASCIIFoldOf(key, jobCircuitKey)
108	}
109	
110	// isCompiledHashKey reports whether key is an accepted spelling of the
111	// compiled-artifact binding field: only "compiled_hash" itself and ASCII
112	// letter-case variants such as "COMPILED_HASH" or "CoMpIlEd_HaSh". Non-ASCII
113	// letters are never folded here; compiledHashLookalike rejects those.
114	func isCompiledHashKey(key string) bool {
115		return isASCIIFoldOf(key, compiledHashKey)
116	}
117	
118	// rejectAmbiguousJobVersion enforces the pinned-version uniqueness rule shared
119	// by the directory scan and the single-record decode (both drive readJobRecord):
120	// the version a job writes is the sole authority for which frozen circuit — and
121	// therefore which trusted setup and compiled artifact — the job belongs to, so
122	// one record may carry the field under at most one recognized spelling
123	// (isJobVersionKey). Two spellings on one record make the bound version depend
124	// on key order, since encoding/json keeps the last value, and corrupt the read:
125	// the whole record is refused whether the values agree or differ, whether both
126	// are legal versions, and whether unrelated members sit between them — neither
127	// value is ever picked to carry on. A single spelling of any recognized kind —
128	// including a lone long-s "verſion" — is the one version field and keeps its
129	// current reading.
130	//
131	// keys are the record's member keys in any order; the recognized spellings are
132	// filtered and sorted here so the message is deterministic. where names the
133	// record exactly as the calling read path already located it (by id when the
134	// scan read one, else by position), so both paths name the problem the same
135	// way.
136	func rejectAmbiguousJobVersion(where string, keys []string) error {
137		var versionKeys []string
138		for _, key := range keys {
139			if isJobVersionKey(key) {
140				versionKeys = append(versionKeys, key)
141			}
142		}
143		if len(versionKeys) <= 1 {
144			return nil
145		}
146		sort.Strings(versionKeys)
147		quoted := make([]string, len(versionKeys))
148		for i, k := range versionKeys {
149			quoted[i] = strconv.Quote(k)
150		}
151		return corruptf("%s carries the pinned version field %q more than once (as %s)",
152			where, jobVersionKey, strings.Join(quoted, ", "))
153	}
154	
155	// rejectAmbiguousJobCircuit enforces the owning-circuit uniqueness rule shared

444	// Strict decoding of a committed job record, including its identity id and its
445	// compiled-artifact binding.

447	// The id is the job's identity and is held to the same exact-readback rule as

477	// even with byte-identical values — are a duplicate binding and corrupt the

481	// would fold them onto the field: its struct-tag matching uses Unicode case

// must denote its value exactly — valid UTF-8 in the literal portions and no

// shapes decode to U+FFFD replacement characters under encoding/json, which
// would rename the circuit on read; they are data corruption, and the whole
// directory read is refused. Only the name is judged this way; every other

package zkcircuit

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

// Differential corpus: exact error text for single-record decode and full open.
func TestDiffCorpus(t *testing.T) {
	good := `{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`
	cases := []string{
		`null`, ``, `   `, `[]`, `[1,2]`, `"x"`, `5`, `true`,
		`{}garbage`, `{"x":1}garbage`,
		good[:0] + `{"name":"mul"}`,
		`{"version":1}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false}`, // missing description
		`{"name":null,"version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":null,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":null,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":"false","description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":1,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":"1.5","constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":7,"version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":1}`,
		`{"note":"x","name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","frzoen":true}`,
		// duplicates
		`{"name":"mul","name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","frozen":true}`,
		`{"frozen":true,"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","name":"x"}`,
		`{"x":1,"x":2,"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"x":1,"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","y":2}`,
		`{"x":1,"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","x":2}`,
		// unknown vs dup precedence interleaved
		`{"a":1,"version":1,"a":2}`,
		// malformed value vs dup
		`{"name":"mul","name":}`,
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","frozen":}`,
		`{"bogus":}`,
		`{"name":"mul","bogus":}`,
		// name encoding
		`{"name":"bad\xff","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"a\uD800","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"\uDC00","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"电路","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		`{"name":"😀","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""}`,
		// definition absent / null / present
		`{"name":"mul","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":"","definition":null}`,
	}

	label := func(err error) string {
		if err == nil {
			return "<ok>"
		}
		var se StoreError
		if errors.As(err, &se) {
			return se.Kind + " | " + se.Detail
		}
		return err.Error()
	}

	for i, rec := range cases {
		// single-record decode
		var pc persistCircuit
		recErr := json.Unmarshal([]byte(rec), &pc)
		fmt.Printf("REC[%02d] %v\n", i, label(recErr))

		// full open: two records so position prefixing shows; record is #2
		env := `{"format":1,"circuits":[` +
			`{"name":"ok","version":1,"constraints":1,"public_inputs":0,"private_inputs":0,"frozen":false,"description":""},` +
			rec + `],"setups":[],"jobs":[]}`
		dir := filepath.Join(t.TempDir(), "bench")
		os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755)
		os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "data.json"), []byte(env), 0o644)
		s, oerr := Open(dir)
		if oerr == nil {
			s.Close()
		}
		fmt.Printf("OPN[%02d] %v\n", i, label(oerr))
	}
}
EOF

## 改动

**新增 `zkcircuit/circuit_record.go`** —— 一条已保存电路记录的唯一读取归宿：
- `readCircuitRecord`：每记录只遍历一次的读取引擎，两处读取（整份数据预检查 `scanCircuitArray` 与单条记录解码 `decodeCircuit`/`persistCircuit.UnmarshalJSON`）共同驱动。它负责识别对象、按 JSON 转义还原后的字段名收集成员，并记录首个重复键（含字节完全相同、含 `\uXXXX` 拼写的重复，且不选取任一值）。
- `circuitRecordScan.judgeScan`：保留预检查的分工——只判对象识别与**精确重复键**，按 `circuit record #N` 定位。
